## Subsystem Status Declaration

### Current Status: ALPHA

**Definition:** The URDF subsystem is in ALPHA status, meaning:

- Core functionality is implemented and working
- Test coverage is being expanded
- Documentation is in progress
- Not yet subject to production CI gates
- Breaking changes may occur

### Path to BETA

To achieve BETA status, the following criteria must be met:

- [ ] 100+ tests passing
- [ ] ≥80% test coverage
- [ ] All critical bugs resolved
- [ ] Documentation complete (quickstart + API reference)
- [ ] CI gates implemented (not yet enforced)

### Path to PRODUCTION

To achieve PRODUCTION status, the following criteria must be met:

- [ ] 200+ tests passing
- [ ] ≥90% test coverage
- [ ] Zero known critical issues
- [ ] Full documentation suite
- [ ] All CI gates passing and enforced
- [ ] Cross-engine validation (MuJoCo, Drake, Pinocchio load successfully)
- [ ] 30-day stability period with no regressions
